scope: Desktop playback edits and Undo while running through plan replacement; unsupported operations refused visibly
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none

desktop-asan.note: Local desktop build with FL_LIVE_SANITIZERS=ON (ASAN detect_leaks=0 for Qt) running playbackEditsAndUndo and the nine updated test functions

verified_behaviors: Level edits while playing apply at the next block: playback edit count increments, the playhead stays at 1.2 instead of resetting, both clips keep playing
Ten rapid edits keep one replacement in flight; the last level wins and each edit keeps its own Undo step
Launch is refused with a visible message while a newer edit awaits its offer and succeeds once it is handed over
Tempo edits and tempo Undo while playing are refused with a message; tempo and history unchanged
Deleting a playing MIDI track stops it; Undo restores the track without its playback; redo/undo while playing
Queued scene launches survive edits made before they render; scene create/copy/delete/slot edits, renames, solo and pattern edits apply while playing
Offscreen QML: delete track while playing keeps the playing clip on its track; Undo button restores it; tempo field disabled while mixer controls stay enabled
Stopped edits still rebuild at the start
limits: Silent preview and offscreen UI; the render result of a live edit is checked at engine level (plan-replacement), not by capturing desktop audio. Edit bursts under host load and backpressure are #55. No physical audio.
